title: Binary all-polymer solar cells with 19.30% efficiency enabled by bromodibenzothiophene-based solid additive
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2024, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE02978J, Paper
Haisheng Ma, Jiali Song, Jiawei Qiao, Bingyu Han, Qianqian Wang, Min Hun Jee, Laju Bu, Donghui Wei, Han Young Woo, Xiaotao Hao, Yanming Sun
Two volatile solid additives were developed to modulate the active-layer morphology of all-polymer solar cells (all-PSCs). Among them, the 4-BDBTP-treated all-PSC achieved an outstanding efficiency of 19.30%.
